name: Query segment contacts
description: Call this when you need the actual contact rows that a segment filter resolves to — either to preview who an unsaved segment definition would match before saving it, or to page through the members of a filter you already hold. Pass the filter as `fe_query` and read contacts from `data`; the matched total comes back in `metadata.contact_count`. Use segments.get_segment_contact_count instead when you only need the size of a segment and not the rows, and use the contacts listing action when you want all contacts or the members of a plain list rather than a filter-defined segment.
preconditions: Any list, attribute, or segment referenced inside fe_query must already exist on the account.
The session must be authenticated against the Brevo web app (this is an internal web-app endpoint, not part of the public API).

fe_query.description: The front-end segment filter definition to evaluate. An empty object matches every contact on the account. The internal filter grammar is not documented by this endpoint's evidence; pass through a definition obtained from the segment builder rather than composing one blind.

page.description: 1-based page number of the result set to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return in this page.

force_refresh.description: When true, re-evaluates the filter instead of serving a cached result set.

data.description: Contacts matching the filter, for the requested page.

attributes.description: Contact attribute values, as rendered for the segment table.

entered.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact was created.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the contact's last modification.

blacklisted.description: Blocklist indicator as returned by this endpoint (0 was observed for non-blocklisted contacts).

sc.description: Message/send counter for the contact as returned by this endpoint.

sib_order.description: Order count attributed to the contact.

pushSubscribed.description: Push subscription state, null when unknown.

is_anonymous.description: Whether the contact is anonymous (tracked without an identified email).

assignTo.description: CRM owner the contact is assigned to, null when unassigned.

nextTaskStartAt.description: Start time of the contact's next CRM task; empty string when there is none.

metadata.description: Result-set metadata for the evaluated filter.

contact_count.description: Number of contacts matching the filter.

total_count.description: Total count reported for the result set.

segmentation.description: Segmentation detail returned alongside the results.

side_effects: A segment result set may be computed and cached server-side, and recomputed when force_refresh is true.
